decisions.reason: As a newly launched line with several models and its own page, it fits the firm's dental materials business and is likely performing at least close enough to aspiration levels for a large firm with slack to continue learning rather than exit quickly.

This thermoforming blank is closely aligned with the firm's established laboratory workflow capabilities and its dedicated presentation suggests sufficient commitment to keep it on the market while early results become clearer.

Because it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, management would see more uncertainty and somewhat weaker evidence of acceptance, but its fit with core materials competence still makes retention more likely than withdrawal.
The product supports the firm's push into digital and clinical workflows and, with a page of its own, would likely be kept unless results fell clearly below aspiration levels.

Custom earmolds are highly consistent with the firm's hearing-care customer base and custom manufacturing strengths, so a large established firm would usually continue the line while exploiting international distribution and service complementarities.

Although this hearing-protection earmold line appears more niche and was only mentioned on the website, it still leverages core earmold capabilities, making continued market presence more plausible than redeploying resources immediately.
